brief:
An Israeli court extended the detention of Gaza doctor Hussam Abu Safia for at least another six months without filing any charges against him, Middle East Eye reported. Abu Safia will remain in Israeli custody under the extended order.

The physician has been held in Israeli detention without formal charges brought against him during the previous period of his incarceration.
dek: Israeli court extends detention of Gaza doctor Hussam Abu Safia Dr Hussam Abu Safia will remain in Israeli detention for at least another six months, after a court extended his detention without bringing any charges against him.
title: Israeli court extends Abu Safia's detention without charges
